name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump issues new orders to limit birthright citizenship, Iran shares details of an agreement with Oman to reopen Strait of Hormuz, Trump under pressure to find a breakthrough with Iran.

changes.title: Is the Iran war at risk of becoming a quagmire?
changes.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel talks to John Sopko, who served as Special Inspector General for Afghanistan under Obama, Trump and Biden, about the back-and-forth around bringing the Iran war to an end.

changes.title: Despite Trump's talk of a deal being close, little has changed to end the Iran war
changes.summary: President Trump is under pressure to find a breakthrough with Iran over the Strait of Hormuz, but it's proven elusive.

changes.title: Trump targets birthright citizenship. And, Iran aims to ban U.S. from Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: President Trump says he has signed two new orders targeting birthright citizenship. And, Iran is aiming to ban U.S. ships from the Strait of Hormuz. (Image credit: Aaron Schwartz).

changes.title: Trump faces calls for windfall tax on big oil’s profits from Iran war
changes.summary: US president’s complaint industry ‘making too much money’ comes after his policies boosted corporations Donald Trump’s statement that oil companies have made “too much money” from the Iran war has angered environmentalists, who say that his policies were designed to benefit those very corporations. If he really believe.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan Sign Joint Defense Pact
changes.summary: The agreement treats an attack on any of the three countries as an attack on all. Saudi Arabia has recently faced drone and missile strikes that it has blamed on Iran’s allies in Yemen and Iraq.

changes.title: The State of Iran’s Three Key Nuclear Sites
changes.summary: The conflict may have slowed, but not stopped, Iran’s nuclear program, officials and experts said.
